name: GB energy supply margins
value: No current notices; last EMN 6 Oct
summary: No NESO or National Gas margin notices found in force as of 11 Nov; NESO issued a precautionary notice on 6 Oct
state: No Electricity Margin Notice, capacity market notice or Gas Margins Notice was found in force as of 11 Nov. NESO's Winter Outlook of 23 Oct says supplies are secure, forecasting a 5.9 GW margin, a 9.5% buffer over peak demand, for the winter to 31 Mar 2027 (NESO). NESO last issued a precautionary Electricity Margin Notice for the evening peak on 6 Oct and said there was no risk to supplies.
for_you: No action is needed. Tighter days are most likely in cold, still spells in mid-winter, when demand rises and wind output falls.
rubric_hit: No NESO or National Gas margin notices in force: Normal line

sources.title: NESO — British electricity supplies secure this winter despite global instability

why: When gas or electricity margins tighten, Britain risks price spikes and, at worst, controlled disconnections in winter.
drivers: Gas imports and storage, wind output, interconnectors, plant outages, cold weather.

rubric.alert: A Gas Deficit Warning, a high risk of demand control notice, or demand control used.
rubric.watch: NESO issues an Electricity Margin Notice or capacity market notice, or National Gas issues a Gas Margins Notice.
rubric.normal: NESO and National Gas report adequate margins; no notices issued.
